contradictions.source: Eadē circunlita sanguine fœminæ suis minē crescunt.
contradictions.english: The same, smeared with the blood of a female sow, makes the breasts grow less.
contradictions.why: The source says the breasts (uber) grow less, but the English says the breasts grow less, omitting the subject 'uber' and potentially confusing the reader.

contradictions.source: Lupi adeps illitus uuluas mollit. Dolores earu etiā cōtra illita noxia ualeat. Et n/ pdest.
contradictions.english: Wolf fat applied softens the womb. It can even be effective against harmful applications to alleviate their pains. And it is not useless.
contradictions.why: The source says 'Et n/ pdest' (And it is not useful/useless), but the English translates it as 'And it is not useless'.
